parsed.rationale: I read this as sinus rhythm with narrow QRS complexes, normal R-wave progression, no pathologic Q waves, and no ST elevation above the threshold or reciprocal changes, so I don't see an anterior MI. V2–V3 show only slight ST elevation with upright T waves, which looks like a normal variant.
